responsibility: Implements GCC’s main language-independent diagnostic engine. This file initializes and owns diagnostic_context behavior, diagnostic classification and counting, warning-as-error handling, option and prefix formatting, caret-width and terminal-width policy, rich-location and path emission, final summaries, output-format selection, and the variadic warning/error/pedwarn/inform entry points that turn frontend and middle-end reports into text, JSON, or SARIF diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Primary implementation source within the diagnostic stem group: it realizes the diagnostic engine APIs and behavior declared in diagnostic.h, while diagnostic.h is the public interface and diagnostic.def is the X-macro data table of diagnostic kinds, prefixes, and color classes that the implementation consumes.
